say:1:1631939001:1.text: I've tried every patch of grass around here.
say:1:1631939001:1.source_cn: 这附近的草我已经吃遍了。
say:1:1631939001:1.male: I've tried every patch of grass around here.
say:1:1631939001:1.female: I've tried every patch of grass around here.

say:2:1631939002:1.text: I can tell how each stalk tastes just by taking a sniff.
say:2:1631939002:1.source_cn: 我现在光是闻一下，就知道这附近的草的味道。
say:2:1631939002:1.male: I can tell how each stalk tastes just by taking a sniff.
say:2:1631939002:1.female: I can tell how each stalk tastes just by taking a sniff.

say:3:1631939003:1.text: But my goal is to become a food critic, which means I'll have to venture further.
say:3:1631939003:1.source_cn: 但想要成为一个美食评论家，不能止步于此。
say:3:1631939003:1.male: But my goal is to become a food critic, which means I'll have to venture further.
say:3:1631939003:1.female: But my goal is to become a food critic, which means I'll have to venture further.

say:4:1631939004:1.text: I can't wait to try different kinds of grass.
say:4:1631939004:1.source_cn: 我想要品尝更多不同的草。
say:4:1631939004:1.male: I can't wait to try different kinds of grass.
say:4:1631939004:1.female: I can't wait to try different kinds of grass.

say:5:1631939005:1.text: When I've finally sampled all the grass in the world...
say:5:1631939005:1.source_cn: 只有品尝完这世上所有草的时候，我才可以骄傲地称自己为……
say:5:1631939005:1.male: When I've finally sampled all the grass in the world...
say:5:1631939005:1.female: When I've finally sampled all the grass in the world...

say:6:1631939006:1.text: I'll become a true gourmet! Baa!
say:6:1631939006:1.male: I'll become a true gourmet! Baa!
say:6:1631939006:1.female: I'll become a true gourmet! Baa!
